# dsh-slash-new
A small DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that adds a single slash command: **`/new`**.
It starts a blank session in the current workspace — the same action as the sidebar's 「新会话」 button a
nd `Cmd+N` — and carries the old session's **permission preset** and **agent preset** over to the ne
w one, so starting fresh never silently widens or narrows what the agent is allowed to do.
## Why it exists
DSH sessions are append-only logs, so there is nothing to truncate in place. "Clearing" a conversati
on means starting a new one and leaving the old log in the sidebar. DSH ships `/compact`, but no `/n
ew` in the desktop composer, and hand-creating a session resets its permission preset to the profile
e desktop composer, and hand-creating a session resets its permission preset to the profile default.
## What `/new` does
| Step | Behaviour |
| 1 | Reads the current session's `permissions` projection (`read-only` / `ask` / `never` / `danger-

full-access` / `auto`) and its `agentPreset` |
| 2 | Creates or reuses a blank session in the **same

workspace**, passing the agent preset to session creation |
| 3 | Opens that session in the main pa

nel |
| 4 | Replays the permission preset by running the host's own `/permission <preset>` command i
n the new session — the same call the permission chip in the composer makes |
The previous session keeps its log and stays in the sidebar. A *custom* (hand-tuned) permission mix
cannot be expressed as a preset, so the new session falls back to the host default and a warning is
logged to the client console.

## Uninstall
[代码示例省略，未执行]
…then drop `"dsh-slash-new"` from `dsh.bundle.bundles` and restart.
## Compatibility
- Tested with DSH desktop `0.2.1-rc.3` (Web renderer). The client half needs `sessions`, `workspaces
` and `uiWorkspace` (blank-session creation, session switching) and the host's `/permission` command

.
- Do not install it alongside another plugin that owns `/new` (for example `deepseek-harness-ultra
-slash`): both register the same command name and both listen to `command/executed`, so a single `/n
ew` would switch sessions twice.

## 中文速览
`/new` 在 DSH 桌面端开启一个空白会话（等同于侧边栏「新会话」/`Cmd+N`），并把当前会话的**权限预设**和**代理预设**带到新会话里，避免一开新会话权限就被重置成默认值。旧会话的日
志仍留在左侧列表。自定义（custom）权限无法用预设表达，新会话会回落到默认并在控制台告警。
安装、卸载和兼容性说明见上方英文部分；装完记得重启 App（客户端 bundle 在启动时编译）。
